versions.changelog: v1.5.0: cloud execution now uses the Market buyer path (market workbook download/validate/quote/run with per-platform listing IDs) instead of the private template-spec path, so buyers can run it with their own account
v1.4.9: user-managed LoomLoom install (no agent global install), enforce exactly one screening decision + one paper_sheet per submitted paper
v1.4.8: remediate ClawHub findings — accurate dual-outbound privacy notice, declared permissions, global human-in-the-loop, UNCONFIRMED gate status, hardened validation
v1.4.7: add MANDATORY cloud onboarding — confirm paid-cloud path, install loomloom via npm, doctor check, platform account + interactive login, fee disclosure before run

V1.4.6: clear the v1.4.5 scan regression and the last language-default finding. (1) removed the SKILL.md self-reference from the bundled-files table, which the scanner read as a referenced artifact it could not fully inspect (AE1); (2) cloud output language is now confirmed with the user before the run instead of being fixed by which package is installed; (3) refreshed the stale version label in the description. Unchanged: the metadata_status contract, the Evidence Record schema, and the template bindings. Left as-is on purpose: the paid-run confirmation ceremony (ClawScan rebuts EA2) and tool/permission scope (the skill schema has no such field).

V1.4.5: security-scan remediation. (1) validator now fails when a completed cloud row is missing its screening/build artifact, and reconciles submitted/audited/incomplete/failed row counts instead of silently skipping rows; the renderer refuses to render a partial pool without --allow-partial. (2) added a cloud-handoff privacy gate: disclose recipient and cost, minimize and redact personal data, and stop before upload if the user does not consent. (3) description and manifest now scope the skill to Literature Review / Medical Science and state what each bundled script does; language rules are now 'default English, assignment may override'; paid-run confirmation and overwrite disclosure tightened.
V1.4.4: validator hardening — reject level-D content-credibility overclaims and enforce record_id-bidirectional paper/reading pool equality.
Initial ClawHub publish (English): v1.4.3 — literature paper screening with paper_sheet + reading_list; intro language/>&channel; offline pre-flight checker.
